candidates.sentence: He will continue to fight for coverage for all of his constituents and stand up any attempt by the Trump administration to repeal the Affordable Care Act or take us backward.
This important bill will ensure that miners will not lose their health insurance or pensions should their coal company declare bankruptcy.
He was proud to support and helped write portions of the 2018 opioid crisis response bill which allocated an additional $8.4 billion to fighting the opioid epidemic on all fronts.
